BVD_AnalogThrottle_Tooltip: Enable progressive throttle input instead of full-on / full-off.
BVD_AutomaticReverse_Tooltip: Engage reverse automatically when the brake key is pressed at a stop.
BVD_CustomizableSteering_Tooltip: Use the steering response sliders below instead of the default steering feel.
BVD_DriftKey_Tooltip: Hold this key while cornering at speed to enter drift mode.
BVD_JoystickThrottle_Tooltip: Enable progressive throttle input for gamepads / joysticks.
BVD_ManualShift_Tooltip: Shift gears manually using the keybinds below.
BVD_NotProperlyInstalled: Better Vehicle Dynamics is missing its Java component. Subscribe to 'better-vehicle-dynamics-42' (the Java side) and restart the game.
BVD_Outdated: Better Vehicle Dynamics: the Java side is out of date. Update 'better-vehicle-dynamics-42' to the latest version and restart the game.
BVD_ShiftDown_Tooltip: Key to shift down one gear.
BVD_ShiftUp_Tooltip: Key to shift up one gear.
BVD_SkidVolume_Tooltip: Volume of the tire-screech sound when a vehicle is sliding.
BVD_TowedSkidding_Tooltip: Also play the tire-screech sound for vehicles being towed.
IGUI_SSXP_debugMode_tooltip: If true, it will show all XP gained and lost without summing them and without any timer.
